exposure: Modified Robson Ten-Group Classification System factors (parity, previous CS, gestational age, fetal presentation, plurality, onset of labor)
indications for CS (previous LSCS, fetal distress, non-progress of labor)
cohort: 100 women delivering at >=28 weeks of gestation in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 60%, with Group 5 (previous CS, single cephalic, >=37 weeks) contributing the highest proportion (37.5%).
mod_finding: Maternal complications and NICU admissions were more common after caesarean sections compared to vaginal births.
